scope: Positive Gaussian-basis mixture DNN pilot; shared flavor/legs, fixed CS and perturbative prescription. No full functional identification or calibrated uncertainty claim.
regularization_definition: Objective includes 0.5*coefficient*sum(theta^2), including biases, excluding normalization nuisance
closure_generation: Independent refined Bessel predictions from analytic x-correlated mixture weights; generator formula not used by optimizer
selection: Lowest training objective; held-out points do not select the seed

optimizer.message: CONVERGENCE: RELATIVE REDUCTION OF F <= FACTR*EPSMCH

function_sensitivity.coordinates: 8 log-x hat functions times 5 relative mixture logits
function_sensitivity.scope: Local sensitivity in declared coordinates; not a unique functional reconstruction or neural-parameter covariance

profile_recovery_scope: Full-profile differences are retained as identifiability/model diagnostics, not a claimed recovery guarantee
